matrixTitle: Kshetra Mobile Application Financial Consumer Compatibility Matrix

summary.unitTestPassRate: 100% (34/34 Jest tests passing, 67/67 Verifier tests passing)

consumers.preFixBehavior: Non-nullable numbers on financial fields, formatINR lacked null check throwing TypeError, computeWealthGrowth produced NaN on nulls, detectRedFlags falsely flagged zero liability anomaly on nulls, ConstituencyIntegrity lacked assetsDisclosedCandidatesCount.
consumers.implementedFix: Updated CandidateAffidavit fields to 'number | null'. Hardened formatINR to return 'Not Disclosed' for null/undefined and '₹0' for 0. Added isAvailable: boolean to WealthGrowth and returned null growths when either totalAssets is null. Guarded detectRedFlags against null liabilities and null assets. Added non-optional assetsDisclosedCandidatesCount: number to ConstituencyIntegrity.
consumers.verificationMethod: Jest sprint14-16.test.ts (6 tests) & Node test suite (Tests 46, 47, 48, 64)

consumers.preFixBehavior: Financial types lacked nullability, local formatINR threw on nulls, red flag detector lacked null guards.
consumers.implementedFix: Converted totalAssets and totalLiabilities to 'number | null'. Hardened formatINR to return 'Not Disclosed' for null/undefined. Guarded detectAllRedFlags against null liabilities.

consumers.preFixBehavior: Potential risk of coercing nullable values during state bundle dispatch.
consumers.implementedFix: Audited: Passes through typed legislator profiles and affidavit data without performing arithmetic, formatting, or zero-coercion. Preserves number | null faithfully.

consumers.component: Legacy Root Financial Breakdown Card (Path Check)
consumers.preFixBehavior: File not present at root components directory.
consumers.implementedFix: Documented canonical component location at apps/mobile/components/legislator/FinancialBreakdownCard.tsx. Zero phantom code at root.

consumers.preFixBehavior: Used '|| 0' fallbacks coercing missing disclosures to zero wealth; rendered stacked breakdown bar even when some components were undisclosed.
consumers.implementedFix: Removed all '|| 0' fallbacks. Added explicit 'Assets not disclosed' banner when totalAssets === null. Enforced complete breakdown rule: all 4 components (movable, immovable, spouse, dependents) must be non-null to render stacked bar; otherwise renders disclosed individual items with explicit unitemized notice. Timeline renders dashed 2px baseline for undisclosed years.
consumers.verificationMethod: TypeScript compiler check (npx tsc --noEmit) & Node test suite (Test 62)

consumers.preFixBehavior: Called formatINR without guarding against unhardened utility, crashed on null growth percent toFixed.
consumers.implementedFix: Guarded latestGrowth.percentGrowth != null before calling toFixed. Passes nullable totalAssets and totalLiabilities to hardened formatINR.

consumers.preFixBehavior: Potential risk of unhandled null in wealth display.
consumers.implementedFix: Audited: Uses hardened formatINR for net worth and asset displays; does not perform raw arithmetic or zero coercions.

consumers.preFixBehavior: Potential risk of unhandled null in wealth display.
consumers.implementedFix: Audited: Uses hardened formatINR for net worth and asset displays; does not perform raw arithmetic or zero coercions.

consumers.preFixBehavior: Computed netWorth using '|| 0' fallbacks, displaying false ₹0 net worth for undisclosed legislators; coerced movable/immovable assets with '|| 0'.
consumers.implementedFix: Removed '|| 0' fallbacks. Computes netWorth = (hasBoth ? totalAssets - liabilities : null). Computes combined assets requiring both movable and immovable non-null. Renders 'Not Disclosed' when netWorth is null. Guarded zero liability anomaly against null liabilities.

consumers.preFixBehavior: Local formatINR helper lacked nullability handling.
consumers.implementedFix: Updated formatINR(val?: number | null) to return 'Not Disclosed' for null/undefined, '₹0' for 0.

consumers.preFixBehavior: Potential risk of arithmetic on nullable fields.
consumers.implementedFix: Audited: Passes profile financials directly to hardened card components and formatINR; no raw arithmetic or zero coercion.

consumers.preFixBehavior: Forced 8px minimum bar height for null assets, visually fabricating positive wealth for undisclosed years.
consumers.implementedFix: Explicitly handles all 4 states: 1) Disclosed positive total with complete breakdown (stacked bar); 2) Disclosed positive total with partial breakdown (solid bar); 3) Disclosed genuine zero (2px solid baseline bar); 4) Undisclosed / null (2px dashed baseline bar). Guarded percentGrowth and annualizedGrowth against null.
consumers.verificationMethod: TypeScript compiler check (npx tsc --noEmit) & Node test suite (Test 67)

consumers.preFixBehavior: Summed assets with '|| 0' and divided by total candidates including undisclosed records, artificially depressing average assets and distorting crorepati percentages.
consumers.implementedFix: Filtered disclosed candidates (a.totalAssets != null) for avgAssets denominator. Computes both disclosedPercent (crorepatis / disclosedCount) and overallPercent (crorepatis / total). Sets required assetsDisclosedCandidatesCount on ConstituencyIntegrity.
consumers.verificationMethod: TypeScript compiler check (npx tsc --noEmit) & Node test suite (Tests 63, 64)

consumers.preFixBehavior: Strict non-nullable number on MP financials.
consumers.implementedFix: Updated MPProfile interface to allow number | null on totalAssets and totalLiabilities.

consumers.preFixBehavior: Risk of coercing nulls during data ingestion.
consumers.implementedFix: Audited: Correctly passes through null values from JSON seed files into typed candidate/legislator objects without zero coercion.
Updated TelanganaMLA interface to allow number | null on financial fields.

consumers.preFixBehavior: LegislatorProfileSummary defined totalAssets as number and isCrorepati as boolean; getSummaries used '|| 0' fallback coercing null assets to ₹0 and isCrorepati to false.
consumers.implementedFix: Updated LegislatorProfileSummary: totalAssets is 'number | null', isCrorepati is 'boolean | null'. Removed '|| 0' in getSummaries; sets isCrorepati = (totalAssets != null ? totalAssets >= 10_000_000 : null).
